jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
As a recruitment company, DCG understands that every business is powered by experienced professionals. Our management style and partnership approach enable us to meet your needs and provide continuous support. Due to our ongoing growth and the large number of recruitment projects we undertake for our partners, we are currently looking for:

**Fullstack Engineer**
----------------------

**Responsibilities:**

* Designing and implementing scalable backend services and RESTful APIs within a domain-driven and event-driven architecture context, including both modular monolith and microservices approaches
* Building and maintaining responsive frontend interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with backend systems
* Contributing to architectural decisions and participating in collaborative design sessions to align technical solutions with business requirements
* Writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; ensuring code quality through thorough code reviews and adherence to team standards
* Working with CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments, and infrastructure as code
* Implementing asynchronous communication patterns and event-based integrations between services
* Configuring and utilising monitoring and observability tools for application diagnostics and performance analysis
* Collaborating within an agile team, working closely with business analysts to refine requirements, and actively participating in sprint ceremonies

  

**Requirements:**

* At least 4 years of experience on a similar position
* Very good knowledge of ASP.NET WebAPI (.NET Core)
* Very good knowledge of React, TypeScript
* Very good knowledge of SQL Server/Azure SQL, EF Core
* Very good knowledge or experience in Unit Testing and GIT
* Good command of English

  

**Offer:**

* Constant support of dedicated consultant
* Employee referral program

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Software Engineer 2**

Remote - Poland *Optional office base in Lublin*

We’re looking for a Software Engineer 2 to join our growing engineering team in Poland and help build secure, high-quality software for the Pharmaceutical Trial Master File (TMF) industry.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a developer who is ready to take the next step - someone who can work independently, contribute to solution design, and help shape how modern software is built in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

You’ll be part of a new team creating software for a specialist pharmaceutical domain, with the chance to use modern AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of everyday delivery.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Fixing moderately complex bugs in familiar code and tackling basic issues in unfamiliar code.
* Building new functionality independently with architectural guidance where needed.
* Developing with .NET and C#, applying SOLID principles, design patterns and dependency injection.
* Writing reliable unit tests and contributing to strong engineering quality standards.
* Using AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while critically reviewing code for quality, security and correctness.
* Collaborating with testers and DevOps, contributing to sprint planning, and helping solve support issues at the root cause.
* Mentoring more junior developers and supporting high coding standards across the team.
* Building your knowledge of the Pharmaceutical TMF domain and applying it in real solutions for clients.

#LI-AT2

.

**What we’re looking for**

* 3+ years of software development experience.
* Strong experience with Microsoft .NET / C#.
* Experience with unit testing, dependency injection, and REST web services.
* Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, Azure SQL or MySQL.
* Exposure to web UI development such as React, Angular or jQuery.
* Confidence using AI-assisted coding tools with a critical eye on output quality and security.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach.

**Why join us**

* Remote role based in Poland.
* Lublin office available if you’d like to work from there - but it’s not a requirement.
* A chance to join a new engineering team and make a visible impact as it grows.
* Opportunity to work in a specialist pharmaceutical technology space with plenty of room to learn and grow.
* Preferred knowledge of GCP and/or TMF is helpful, but not essential.

If you’re a software engineer who enjoys solving problems, writing quality code and working with modern tools in a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 - .NET - Allegro Klik/Care
jobs.description:
Location:
Warszawa, PL, 00-841

Company: Allegro Pay sp. z o.o.

Team: Technology

Contract Type: Employee

Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users.

  

#### **The role**

  

We're looking for a Software Engineer with solid, proven experience in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects — building new products and features from the ground up. You'll take ownership of designing and delivering seamless, end-to-end customer journeys — from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll drive improvements in system performance, scalability, and reliability, and help raise the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, translating ideas into robust technical solutions, and collaborate with and support less experienced teammates as the team grows.

  

Our team builds and scales two products:

  

* **Allegro Klik** - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns.
* **Allegro Care** - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform.

Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems.

  

### **Important things for you:**

  

* Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
* The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):

  + PLN gross 14 600 - 20 825
  + Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
* Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.

### **Here's why you should join us:**

  

* **AI-Adoption strategy:** we invest a lot of effort to upskill our specialists and equip them with the newest AI coding technologies like Copilot or OpenCode.
* **Big Scale:** immerse yourself in the exciting world of Allegro Pay, where your .NET skills will tackle challenges on a large scale. You'll be contributing to financial solutions that affect over 2.5 million people (handling 60+ million requests daily and managing dozens of terabytes of data).
* **Engineering Maturity:** Join a culture that mirrors the top tech giants. Our commitment to engineering excellence and maturity puts us on par with industry leaders like FAANG companies. (11 of 12 in Pragmatic Engineer Score)
* **Best-in-Class Expertise:** Work alongside the best experts in the field, collaborating to push the boundaries of what's possible in FinTech. Our team includes MVPs and many conference speakers.
* **Impactful Products:** Imagine this – your work at Allegro Pay contributes to creating products that you, your family, and friends might already use daily. See the direct impact of your efforts on the FinTech landscape (with 120+ deployments per month).

### **We are looking for people who:**

  

* Have solid, hands-on experience with **.NET** and backend development, and are ready to apply it on production-grade systems
* Have practical experience with **distributed systems and microservices**; exposure to partner APIs is a plus
* Are comfortable working with cloud infrastructure(preferably **Azure**)
* **Want to be proud of the code they create;** value high-quality code reviews and engage in substantive discussions on software engineering best practices
* Are eager to understand the broader business context and communicate effectively with internal clients
* Demonstrate a high sense of responsibility and resilience, as you will be working with critical financial data
* **Are enthusiastic about AI** and are open to actively incorporating AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot) into their daily work to maximize efficiency and focus on complex problem-solving
* **Can independently design and deliver effective solutions** to the requirements set by business stakeholders, taking full ownership of the features they build from start to finish
* Are committed to continuous learning, open to constructive feedback, and embrace a growth mindset through active participation in code reviews, backlog grooming, team discussions and retrospectives
* Collaborate effectively within a team, share knowledge, and are willing to support less experienced teammates as the team grows
* Speak fluent Polish (essential for daily communication with internal and partner stakeholders) and communicative English (at least B2 level)

### **What's in it for you:**

  

* Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
* A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
* A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
* English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
* A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
* An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
* Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

  

### **#goodtobehere means that:**

  

* You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
* You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
* You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
* You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
* You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
* You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300k+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
* You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

**Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!**
----------------------------------------------------

Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.

**About COMSOL**
----------------

COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.

**Role**
--------

Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.

In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.

You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.

The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.

Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.

**Qualifications**
------------------

For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
* Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
* Several years of professional software development experience.
* An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
* Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
* Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
* Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
* Build and development automation.
* Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.

**Working at COMSOL**
---------------------

At COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.

New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.

We also offer:

* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.

**To Apply**
------------

Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish Make sure to include:

* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.

For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.

We review applications continuously.



**Reference**

REF-10051

  

**Job title**

Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform

  

**Location**

Stockholm, Sweden
